Simulating and estimating power for a t-test


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(ggplot2)

n <- 30
m1 <- 0
m2 <- 0.3
# m2 - m1 = 0.3
s2 <- 1

g1 <- rnorm(n, m1, sqrt(s2))
g2 <- rnorm(n, m2, sqrt(s2))

dat <- data.frame(
  y = c(g1, g2),
  x = rep(0:1, each = n)
)

ggplot(dat, aes(x = y)) +
  geom_density(aes(fill = factor(x)),
               alpha = 0.5) 
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](data-simulation-example_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-2-1.png){width=672}
:::

```{.r .cell-code}
B <- 1000

p <- replicate(B, {
  g1 <- rnorm(n, m1, sqrt(s2))
  g2 <- rnorm(n, m2, sqrt(s2))
  t.test(g2, g1)$p.value
})

mean(p <= 0.05)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] 0.222
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}
pwr::pwr.t.test(n = n, d = 0.3)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```

     Two-sample t test power calculation 

              n = 30
              d = 0.3
      sig.level = 0.05
          power = 0.2078518
    alternative = two.sided

NOTE: n is number in *each* group
```

A more structured simulation:


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
sim_data <- function(n, d, s){
  g1 <- rnorm(n, 0, s)
  g2 <- rnorm(n, d, s)
  dat <- data.frame(
    y = c(g1, g2),
    x = rep(0:1, each = n)
  )
  return(dat)
}

fit_model <- function(data){
  t.test(y ~ x, data = data)$p.value
}

n <- c(10, 30, 50, 100)
res <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(n))

for(i in 1:length(n)){
  res[[i]] <- replicate(B, {
    dat <- sim_data(n[i], 0.5, 1)
    fit_model(dat)
  })
}

plot(n, sapply(res, function(x) mean(x <= 0.05)), type = "b")
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](data-simulation-example_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-3-1.png){width=672}

Simulating a GLM


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
n <- 100
x <- rep(0:1, each = n)
age <- round(runif(n*2, 18, 50))
age0 <- age - mean(age)

b0 <- log(10)
b1 <- log(1)
b2 <- log(1.1)

mu <- b0 + b1 * x + b2 * age0
y <- rpois(n = n*2, exp(mu))

fit <- glm(y ~ x + age0, family = poisson())

summary(fit)$coefficients
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```

(Intercept) 2.26882170 0.031950948 71.009527  0.000000e+00
x           0.07013599 0.037234041  1.883652  5.961203e-02
age0        0.09516193 0.002476472 38.426412 4.940656e-323
```
